title: TCAQ - First Friday

sections.markdown:
**Date**

Friday, December 4, 2026

**Time**

3:00 PM - 8:00 PM

**Address**

[The Clubs at Quantico, 3017 Russell Rd, Quantico, VA 22134](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=38.51022301434779,-77.31061124440777)

**Contact**

Phone: [703.784.4264](tel:703.784.4264)

**First Friday**

Officers/Staff NCO and their civilian counterparts come together to strengthen camaraderie and foster esprit de corps.

Complimentary appetizers and non-alcoholic beverages for the first 30 minutes.

This event occurs on the first Friday of each month.

Where: Officer/SNCO Bar at The Clubs at Quantico

For more information call, 703.784.4264.
